description: ezechiel203@big.docbetry.fr
title: ezechiel203@big.docbetry.fr
macOS FUSE signal trampoline absent
description: §5-sonnet C-1: crates/pcloud-fs/src/platform/macos.rs:236 — SIGTERM leaves kernel mount attached. Mirror Linux sigaction+reaper fix. FIX-PLAN P1-3.

notes.content: Fixed in macos.rs: added sigaction-based SIGTERM/SIGINT trampoline with SA_RESTART flags (replacing the TODO log.warn stub). Handler flips an AtomicBool and notifies a Condvar (both async-signal-safe on Darwin). Dedicated pcloud-fuse-t-reaper thread blocks on the Condvar and, on wake, walks a process-wide registry of live fuse_session pointers calling fuse_session_exit on each — which unblocks fuse_session_loop on the loop thread and lets teardown_macos run fuse_unmount / fuse_session_destroy cleanly. register_active_session is called from mount_with_fuse_t after fuse_lowlevel_new succeeds. A pub(crate) deregister_active_session helper is exposed for teardown_macos (documented TODO: mount_service.rs teardown_macos must wire this in to close the destroy-then-signal race). Mirrors the Linux sigaction+reaper pattern per FIX-PLAN P1-2.

description: §5-opus C-2 / §5-sonnet C-2: crates/pcloud-fs/src/platform/macos_ffi.rs:127-143 passes Rust struct size to fuse_lowlevel_new instead of libfuse sizeof(fuse_lowlevel_ops). notes.content: Fixed in macos_ffi.rs + macos.rs: added LowlevelOpsCompat full-layout mirror of libfuse 2.9 fuse_lowlevel_ops with pub const LOWLEVEL_OPS_SIZE = size_of::<LowlevelOpsCompat>(). Live-mac verification still required under bd-1du.4.
